quote: I am a man, and nothing that concerns a man do I deem a matter of indifference to me.
source: Terence, Heauton Timorumenos, Act 1, scene 1, line 77 (Chremes) (trans. Henry Thomas Riley, 1874)
speaker: Chremes

evidence.where: Perseus Digital Library, Riley’s translation of Heautontimorumenos, Act 1, scene 1, with the Latin (Homo sum: humani nihil a me alienum puto) in the footnote
evidence.edition: The Comedies of Terence, trans. Henry Thomas Riley, Harper and Brothers, New York, 1874

reason: Riley’s 1874 prose reads exactly as proposed, spoken by Chremes to Menedemus in the opening scene; line 77 is the Latin line number, which the locator keeps. Not shipped, not banned, first use of Terence.
